function_health.name: Function Health
function_health.what_they_do: Consumer lab testing platform. 100+ biomarkers, trend tracking, reference ranges. No AI clinical decision support. No biological age computation. No compound recommendations.
what_they_lack: No hallmark scoring (9 hallmarks of aging)
function_health.longivity_advantage: Longivity adds the clinical intelligence layer on top of the same lab data: PhenoAge acceleration, hallmark scoring, MR-validated compound recommendations, and N-of-1 trial design.

fountain_life.name: Fountain Life
fountain_life.what_they_do: Full-body diagnostics (MRI, DEXA, bloodwork, genetics). Biological age score. Physician-led. No AI clinical decision support layer — physicians interpret manually.
what_they_lack: No MR evidence tiers for compounds
fountain_life.longivity_advantage: Longivity automates the clinical decision layer that Fountain Life physicians currently do manually: hallmark scoring, compound ranking by MR evidence, and N-of-1 trial design.

superpower.name: Superpower
superpower.what_they_do: Consumer biomarker tracking + biological age. Wearable integration. Trend tracking. No clinical decision support. No compound recommendations. No clinic workflow.
superpower.longivity_advantage: Longivity is the clinic-grade version: multi-patient dashboard, MR-validated compound protocols, N-of-1 trial engine, and genetic risk — all missing from Superpower.

dossier_health.name: Dossier Health
dossier_health.what_they_do: Longevity report generation for clinics. PDF lab import. Biological age score. Static report output — no real-time assessment engine, no compound recommendations, no longitudinal tracking.
what_they_lack: Static reports only — no interactive dashboard
dossier_health.longivity_advantage: Longivity is a live clinical intelligence platform vs. Dossier's static report generator. Real-time PhenoAge, hallmark scoring, compound protocols, and N-of-1 trials — not a PDF.

elysium_health.name: Elysium Health
elysium_health.what_they_do: Epigenetic biological age test (Index) + NMN/NAD+ supplements. Annual test + trend tracking. No clinical decision support. No compound recommendations beyond their own supplements.
what_they_lack: No compound recommendations (only their own supplements)
elysium_health.longivity_advantage: Longivity uses standard blood biomarkers (not epigenetic kits) for real-time clinical decisions. Compound recommendations are MR-validated across all compounds, not limited to proprietary supplements.
